/LILIAN

Baltic Exchange Market Report 15 June 2026
Baltic Dry Index: 2720 (-9)
Baltic Capesize Index: 4053 (-54)
Baltic Panamax Index: 2291 (8)
Baltic Supramax Index: 1664 (22)
Baltic Handysize Index: 905 (5)
CAPESIZE
A sluggish and softer start to the week for the market, with the BCI 5TC slipping $495 to $36,756, with sentiment remaining subdued across both basins and limited conviction from market participants. C5 remained relatively flat, edging down just $0.130 to $10.760, while C3 experienced a more notable correction, falling $0.946 to $34.509. In the Pacific, activity showed a slight improvement compared to late last week, although the market remained broadly flat. Despite the presence of three miners, which would ordinarily be expected to provide support, rates struggled to gain traction. Early bids were reported around $10.50 before one miner fixed at $10.75 and a second followed at $10.80, leaving the market little changed overall. The Atlantic opened with weaker sentiment and a somewhat muted tone. Offers for index-dates on C3 were heard in the high $34s, although a noticeable lack of bids, kept downward pressure on sentiment.
PANAMAX
Market sources reported that trans Atlantic and fronthaul routes are largely maintaining last week’s positive sentiment, despite relatively subdued activity levels. Brokers noted that prompt tonnage remains tight out of both the North Continent and the Western Mediterranean. This has been reflected in the P5TC today with it marking an increase of $72 to $20,617. In the Pacific, sentiment has softened slightly, although owners appear reluctant to lower their rate expectations, resulting in an ongoing standoff. Market participants also highlighted comparatively stronger enquiry from Indonesia, however, overall activity remains cautious, with both owners and charterers preferring to hold their positions until there is greater clarity on market direction before entering firm negotiations. Messrs Harmony Bulkers DMCC were reported today to have taken the Xin Hai Tong 811 (81,687 2013) open in Gopalpur 17 June for 2 laden legs at $21,000.

Atlantic
The Tai Knight (82,100 2022) open in Eren 20/21 June fixed a Black Sea grains run (excluding Ukraine/Russia) to the Red Sea basis redelivery Port Said at around $24,000 to ADM, meanwhile the Aeolian Sunrise (81,793 2014) open in Fujairah 29 May was reported to have been placed on subjects for an East Coast South America trans Atlantic trip, but further details lacked. Oldendorff were said to have taken the Geopride (81,902 2013) open in Karaikal 08 June for an East Coast South American round trip at $22,000, whilst the Guo Yuan 12 (75,946 2012) open in Dahej 25 June was described to have fixed a similar run. The scrubber fitted Proteas (93,048 2010) open in Gangavaram 20/25 June was said to have been fixed, with some suggesting loading from East Coast South America, but no other details or further clarity surfaced.

Asia
The scrubber fitted Ionic Kleos (82,250 2014) open Dadong 21/22 June was noted to have been placed on subjects for a trip from East Coast Australia to India, but no rate or charterer came to light. The Yarra (78,184 2015) open in Zhuhai 19 June was said to have fixed a Pacific round to Tongli but no rate was reported.
SUPRAMAX
A busy and positive start to the week especially in the Atlantic. The US Gulf remains the hottest area with S1C and S4A both showing significant gains, but sources also said the Mediterranean has seen good improvements and there remains plentiful enquiry still to be covered. Asia has been more muted but the indices remained mostly positive. Monfort were rumoured to have relet a Cosco Zhoushan built Ultramax delivery ex yard November/December for 3 years at $17,500 but the Charterer has not been revealed. The 11TC average today rose $283 to $21,039.

Atlantic
In the Mediterranean Centurion were linked with a 58,000 delivery Egypt at $14,000 for a clinker run to Lome, whilst a 56,000 was said to be placed on subjects basis delivery Canakkale for loading Marmara to Dakar/Tema range at the same level. Dead Sea Works booked an unnamed Supramax at $9,500 for a trip via Ashdod to EC South America and an Ultramax agreed at $23,000 for a trip from the East Mediterranean to Bangladesh. There was talk of US Gulf to the Mediterranean trips being concluded now in the mid $30,000’s, with $35,000 rumoured for a petcoke cargo, but further details were lacking.

Asia
The XH Virtue (61,398 2013) open North China 18 June fixed a trip to West Africa at $25,000 whilst the Marilucky (51,052 2017) open Tokuyama end of June was reported fixed for a trip to the Mediterraean via Gulf of Aden in the low $20,000’s with bagged cargo, but in both cases the Charterer was not reported. The ZY Kunshan (63,748 2025) open CJK was clean fixed to HMM with steel slabs to US West Coast with the market reporting a rate of $20,000, however a close source said the rate was much lower, and the Sophiana (61,620 2016) open Koh Sichang 15/17 June fixed a trip via Australia with grains to China in the mid $18,000's with Bunge. In the Indian Ocean, Oldendorff appeared to be very active and were said to be placed on subjects with the Puerto Rosario (64,689 2014) open Mombasa 8/10 June for a trip via South Africa to Singapore-Japan at $23,000, likewise having the Darya Heera (61,083 2021) open Hambantota 11/15 June placed on subjects for the same route at $18,500.
HANDYSIZE
The week opened on a positive note for the Handy sector, with the BHSI gaining 5 points to 905 and the 7TC average rising by $94 to $16,289. In the Continent and Mediterranean, activity remained relatively muted, with charterers largely keeping bids around last-done levels. The South Atlantic displayed a firmer tone, supported by slightly stronger bids and offers that pointed to improving confidence. Despite limited reported fixtures, the US Gulf also remained active, with steady cargo demand and a tightening tonnage list underpinning stronger fundamentals and sustaining momentum. Across Asia, the market was broadly flat, with both tonnage supply and cargo availability holding steady across the main loading areas.

Atlantic
The Izumo Hermes (37,301 2020), open Iskenderun on 11/13 June, was heard fixed for a trip delivery Arzew to the US Gulf with bagged cement at $11,000, with a split after 45 days, by Supreme Bulk Carriers. In addition, a 37,000 open in the Baltic on 19/23 June was heard fixed for a trip from the Baltic to the West Mediterranean at $13,500, although further details were not confirmed.

Asia
A 42,000 open in East Australia was heard placed on subjects for a trip to the Far East at $26,000, although further details were not confirmed.

ai_analysis.summary: 干散货市场分化明显，好望角型船延续跌势，BCI下滑54点至4053，大西洋市场情绪偏弱；巴拿马型船稳中有升，P5TC上涨72美元至20617美元；超灵便型船表现最佳，11TC均值上涨283美元至21039美元，特别是美湾航线大幅走强。整体来看，即期市场活跃度不足但情绪尚稳，远期市场出现卖压。

sections.title: Market Structure
sections.content: BDI下跌9点至2720，连续性疲弱主要来自好望角型船拖累。Capesize现货市场降温，C3航线下跌0.946美元至34.509美元。巴拿马型船凭借大西洋航线紧张运力支撑走稳，超灵便型船受美湾和地中海需求旺盛推动逆势上扬。整体运力供需结构未发生根本性改变，市场仍处观望状态。

sections.title: Dry Bulk Signals
sections.content: 美湾至中国航线超预期火爆，S1C_63单日跳涨2014美元至31143美元；S4A_63大幅上扬1350美元至31854美元。好望角型船C3出现明显回调，卖方压力显现。巴拿马型船印尼方向询盘增多但成交谨慎。铁矿石现货价格微涨0.35美元至101.95美元，焦煤价格略降0.4美元。远期市场Cape Jul合约受压下跌950美元，PMX曲线前端走弱。

sections.title: Trading Focus
sections.content: 重点关注超灵便型船美湾相关航线的高溢价机会，大西洋至红海、孟加拉航线成交活跃。套利窗口在US Gulf-Mediterranean航线已关闭。FFA市场Cape Q3合约成交区间29750-30150，Cal27在26400-26600有少量成交。货物端关注印尼煤炭和澳大利亚铁矿发货节奏。

market_watch: 超灵便型船美湾航线S1C_63单日暴涨2014美元，反映区域运力紧张加剧
好望角型船C3航线下跌0.946美元，现货市场卖压显现
巴拿马型船大西洋端运力持续紧张，P5TC逆势上涨
FFA市场Cape Jul合约跌破29000关口，卖方主导
Oldendorff在印度洋和东南亚市场活跃度提升

route_focus.view: 持续回调，FFA市场同步走弱，Jun合约在33000-35000区间波动，卖方压力较大。即期C3听到高价34美元但缺乏成交支撑，短期偏弱整理。
大西洋至远东航线维持高位，Xin Hai Tong 81万吨船成交21000美元/天。运力收紧叠加旺季预期，支撑该航线保持坚挺，但FFA Q3/Q4曲线显示远期升水收窄。
Skaw-Passero至南美东海岸航线小幅上涨43美元至7129美元，南大西洋情绪好转带动即期市场信心恢复，整体handysize板块偏暖。
